groups.name: Short brand-only page title
groups.definition: Is the document title just a short brand or organization name, with no tagline, keywords or subtitle?

groups.name: Short concise title, not keyword-stuffed
groups.definition: Is the document title short and concise rather than a long keyword-stuffed or descriptive string (including brand–descriptor forms)?

groups.name: Brand plus tagline title
groups.definition: Does the document title combine the brand name with a descriptive tagline or phrase separated by a pipe, dash or similar?

groups.name: Title repeats hero headline
groups.definition: Does the document title incorporate or repeat the hero headline text?

groups.name: Title with byline or product brand list
groups.definition: Does the document title list product brands or an author byline instead of a keyword phrase?

groups.name: Title uses pipe and curly apostrophes
groups.definition: Does the document title use a pipe separator together with typographic curly apostrophes?

groups.name: Typographic curly quotes and dashes
groups.definition: Does the copy use typographic punctuation such as curly apostrophes, curly quotes, en dashes or em dashes?

groups.name: Arrow glyphs on links and labels
groups.definition: Do links, card titles or buttons end with a text arrow glyph such as →?

groups.name: Subtitle microcopy beneath headings or banners
groups.definition: Does a heading, hero or banner have a short descriptive subtitle or tagline line beneath it?

groups.name: Persuasive marketing microcopy
groups.definition: Does the copy use marketing-style taglines, badges, friendly CTAs and promotional phrasing?

groups.name: Condensed low word-count copy
groups.definition: Is the page copy condensed, with fewer words and dropped lists or teasers?

groups.name: Calm tone, few exclamation marks
groups.definition: Is the tone calm with no or few exclamation marks?

groups.name: Casual lowercase friendly copy
groups.definition: Is secondary copy short, casual and lowercase with a personal tone?

groups.name: Sentence or title case labels
groups.definition: Do labels and microcopy use sentence or title case rather than all lowercase or uppercase?

groups.name: Short uppercase section headings
groups.definition: Are sections introduced with short uppercase headings or eyebrow labels?

groups.name: Full untruncated news headlines
groups.definition: Are news headlines shown in full without truncation?

groups.name: Contact details as short link text
groups.definition: Are contact details shown as short link text or plain text rather than raw addresses or forms?

groups.name: Descriptive category hero headline
groups.definition: Is the hero headline a short descriptive category phrase rather than an artwork title?

groups.name: Prices bold with 'from $' prefix
groups.definition: Are prices shown in bold accent color with a 'from $' prefix for variable pricing?
